name: codegraph_routing
description: Laya codegraph read-side query routing. Fork of laya_mem routing.json with code-specific question wording: 6 noul judgments allocate per-view retrieval budget over the code graph (semantic FTS / call-chain / entity lookup / recent files / multi-hop / recency). Single node, copy_keys: returns the 6 raw 0..1 scores; caller applies largest-remainder to turn them into a per-view budget. The offline heuristic backend reads 6 state hints (route_semantic, route_temporal, route_causal, route_entity, route_multi_hop_need, route_recency) — the caller MUST set all six explicitly; a missing hint falls back to substring-matching the whole serialised state and can cross-fire on other questions.

semantic.instructions: Would a full-text search over symbol names / docstrings / signatures help answer `query` about the codebase?
semantic.truthy: Symbol-name or docstring search is useful.

temporal.instructions: Does answering `query` require recently-changed files or the latest revision of a function?
temporal.falsy: Code history is irrelevant to the answer.

causal.instructions: Does answering `query` require following the call chain (who calls X, what X calls, who extends X)?
causal.truthy: A call-chain or inheritance walk is needed.
causal.falsy: The answer does not depend on the call graph.

entity.instructions: Does `query` name a specific symbol, file or module (entity lookup by qualified_name)?
entity.truthy: A specific symbol/file is being asked about.
entity.falsy: The query is thematic rather than a named entity.

multi_hop_need.instructions: Does answering `query` require combining at least two distinct code-graph pieces (e.g. a caller chain of depth ≥ 2, or a caller + callee merge)?
multi_hop_need.truthy: The question needs a graph walk of depth ≥ 2.
multi_hop_need.falsy: One hop or a direct lookup suffices.

recency_importance.instructions: Does `query` ask about the latest revision / a recent change rather than timeless code?
